$comment: Roles come from the sheet's Scoring Schema 'Role' column (Scored / Gate / Moderator). role_overrides lets GG change a role here without touching the workbook (empty by default). Gates are pass/fail qualification flags and are NEVER part of the weighted sum: a failed gate leaves both axis scores unchanged and sets qualification_flag with the reason, so the account is routed to extra qualification work before a pilot is proposed.

prior_open_innovation_usage.fails_when: trigger status present (zero documented prior open-innovation usage)
prior_open_innovation_usage.fail_strength_calibration: TO_CALIBRATE: 1.0 means only a categorical 'trigger' observation (or strength exactly 1.0) fails the gate. Lower it only if graded observations should fail earlier; it is a cutoff, so it was not invented.
prior_open_innovation_usage.reason: No documented prior open-innovation channel usage: no proven execution track record. Qualify before proposing a pilot.

digital_lead_role_present.fails_when: trigger status present (no named digital/innovation lead role)
digital_lead_role_present.reason: No named digital/innovation lead: no internal owner for the pilot, even an interested company tends to stall at approval. Qualify before proposing a pilot.

approval_chain_depth.fails_when: trigger status present (high approval depth: multiple approval layers)
approval_chain_depth.reason: Deep multi-layer approval chain for new vendors/pilots: long, complex sale. Qualify before proposing a pilot.
